title: Export a table to html, Excel or Markdown (wrapper) — tab_export
text: x table made tab tab_reg, list tab. list tables sharing col_vars (tab_vars) merged one; list — several row_vars /tab_vars — rendered one table another, keeping sub-tables. format One "html" (default), "md" (Markdown), "xl" (Excel) "forest" (forest plot estimates, see forest_plot). path Optional output file. "xl" workbook path; "md" "html" rendered text written ; ignored "forest". theme default ("light") white table black text; "dark" inverse (colours follow theme). "auto" follows reader's colour scheme (operating system, dark-mode toggle host page); needs stylesheet, works format = "html" "md" resolves "light" static "xl" backend. black--white publication palettes render table page colour: "print_ready" picks right one per table, name – "print_marks", "print_emphasis", "print_minimalistic" ("bw"). Defaults getOption("tabxplor.theme"). See tab_css says. color Set FALSE render table without colours (monochrome). color_legend Print colour legend table (subtext). TRUE default, -op table carries colours. lang Colour-legend language: NULL (auto R/OS locale, English fallback), "en" "fr". transpose Set TRUE transpose table export (rows become columns) – col-percentages--several-row-variables use case. caption single caption / title table. var_names variable names write beside table: "" (default), "rows", "cols" "none". row-variable name leading column table several row_vars uses name block (written per block); column-variable names spanning row level columns. Level headers always keep name. ... Format-specific arguments passed underlying exporter. Retired arguments (color_type, html_24_bit, engine, html_font, full_width, position, n_min, hide_near_zero) caught , reported , forwarded; exporter hands refuses anything else use.

title: What a table cell shows: the display grammar — tabxplor-display
text: Every function builds table takes display argument, set_display() changes afterwards. page vocabulary: fields cell may show, named layouts arrange . Choosing display never triggers computation never changes number — every field already stored cell (see fmt), set_display() finished table gives exactly asking call .

title: What a table cell shows: the display grammar — tabxplor-display
text: Three ways ask, shortest: named layout: display = "est_ci", "base_ratio", "mean_sd". single field: display = "ci", "diff", "n". {} template : "{est} ({base})", "{pct} [{n}]". template, primary field first one written outside brackets — aside may come first, "({base}) {est}", without ceasing aside. primary carries significance stars, Excel writes get_num() returns, part colours paint. field may carry precision, "{est:3} ({base:1})", beats every default — way set aside's decimals independently estimate's. est base scale-relative: est whatever column estimates (percentage, mean difference, odds ratio) base level sits . lets one layout name mean thing tab() crosstab tab_reg() regression table. field nothing show renders blank keeps width, column stays aligned; field empty whole column dropped, note says argument filled .

title: What a table cell shows: the display grammar — tabxplor-display
text: fields {} template may name, display may name . pct — percentage. n — count. wn — weighted count. mean — mean. Needs numeric col_var. est — estimate, whatever column estimates — odds ratio, risk difference, coefficient, percentage. one token means thing every table. base — level estimate sits : percentage, mean count. plain percentage table number est; beside regression effect adjusted prediction. Needs column level beside estimate. diff — difference reference. Needs ref compare , pct = "row" / "col". ratio — ratio reference (relative risk, ratio means). Needs ref compare , pct = "row" / "col". ci — confidence interval whatever column compares, [low;high]. Needs ci = "ref"  (ci = "cell" cell's interval). moe — margin error — interval ci, written half-width +/-x around estimate. Void column compares RATIO: ratio's interval symmetric LOG scale, half-width. Needs ci = "ref"  (ci = "cell" cell's interval). — odds ratio. Needs pct = "row" / "col"  (odds ratio needs percentage base). ctr — cell's contribution chi-squared. Needs test = TRUE  (contributions come chi-squared). var — variance. Needs numeric col_var. sd — standard deviation, variable's unit. Needs numeric col_var. cv — coefficient variation — standard deviation percentage mean. Needs numeric col_var whose mean positive. resid — adjusted standardized residual – whether cell departs independence. Derived p-value sign ctr, read-. Needs test = TRUE  (residual comes chi-squared). obs — OBSERVED (crude) effect modelled one compared . tab_reg() tables . Needs tab_reg(empirical = TRUE)  (observed effect compare model ). coef — estimate model's LINK scale — coefficient linear log-link model fitted. number est column already additive, logarithm column shows ratio. Needs tab_reg() column (crosstab estimates coefficient). gap — far adjustment moved effect: gap modelled estimate observed counterpart, estimate's scale. color = "adjustment" grades — readable print Excel, html tooltip. Needs tab_reg(empirical = TRUE)  (model effect observed counterpart).

title: What a table cell shows: the display grammar — tabxplor-display
text: named layouts display accepts. spelt scale-relative {est} / {base} fields, one name means thing crosstab tab_reg table: "est" ({est}) — estimate alone. "est_ci" ({est} {ci}) — estimate confidence interval. "est_base" ({est} ({base})) — estimate , parentheses, level sits . "est_base_once" ({est}) — estimate alone — level stated , observed column beside . "est_coef" ({est} ({coef})) — estimate , parentheses, model's coefficient. "base_est_mdiff" ({est} ({diff})) — estimate , parentheses, comparison difference. "base_est_mratio" ({est} ({ratio})) — estimate , parentheses, comparison ratio. "est_obs" (({obs}) {est}) — estimate , parentheses, observed (crude) effect compared . "base_est" (({base}) {est}) — level, estimate — mirror est_base, sets crude modelled effect side side. "base" ({base}) — level alone: percentage, mean count. "base_ci" ({base} {ci}) — level confidence interval. "base_moe" ({base} {moe}) — level margin error. "base_diff" ({base} ({diff})) — level , parentheses, difference reference. "base_ratio" ({base} ({ratio})) — level , parentheses, ratio reference. "base_or" ({base} ({})) — level , parentheses, odds ratio. "or_base" ({} ({base})) — odds ratio , parentheses, percentage rests . "mean_sd" ({mean} (σ{sd})) — mean , parentheses, standard deviation. "mean_cv" ({mean} (cv {cv})) — mean , parentheses, coefficient variation — spread percentage mean, comparable columns measured different units (default every mean positive).

LADDER render-time reading cell's stored p-value, option alone — change every table already built shows new glyphs. Per-call stars =. tabxplor.ratio_print "inverse" (default): prints multiplicative value reference inverse — odds ratio 0.37 1/2.67, mean ratio 0.42 /2.4 — "2.7 times less" reads strongly "2.7 times ", bracket. "raw" prints plain number (0.37), convention journals. tabxplor.n "range" (default): many people table says behind numbers. "range" puts unweighted base beside Total cell crosstab (100% (9 838)) n column regression table, printed min-max blocks rest different populations — several column variables losing different NAs, several models. "min" prints smallest base , "" shows count . replaces add_n argument, deprecated 2.0.0. Per-call n =. tabxplor.color_whole_cell FALSE (default): EXPERT. cell prints SEVERAL fields reads one number aside — 1/1.63*** (31%) — cell's rendering grades number aside set slightly back table's text, following theme. covers colour , theme = "print", typography (bold, italic, underline) alike. Set TRUE extend primary's rendering whole cell instead (pre-2.0.0 look). nothing choose beyond : grey aside takes belongs theme's palette, per-cell option — see set_color_palette(). Console, html Markdown; Excel renders cell whole either way. tabxplor.var_names "" (default): variable names exporters annotate: "", "rows", "cols", "none". Per-call var_names =. tabxplor.var_labels FALSE (default): exports (markdown / html / Excel / plot), show variable's label (haven/labelled label attribute, one) instead name. Display – table structure keeps canonical names, name-based select() references still work; console always shows names. tabxplor.cleannames FALSE (default): clean variable/level names output. Also strips "1-"-style prefix labelled value labels turned factor levels. Per-call cleannames =. tabxplor.total_names c(row = "Total", col = "Total", tab = "Ensemble", = "Others") (default): four synthetic labels table carries: row col name total row total column, tab total table (one made tab_vars), level other_if_less_than lumps small levels . partial vector allowed – options(tabxplor.total_names = c(tab = "Ensemble", = "Autres")) leaves first two alone. replaces total_names / totaltab_name / other_level arguments, deprecated 2.0.0. tabxplor.shape_auto_max 12L (default): shape = "auto" draws line numeric row tab variable: column many distinct whole values counted number short scale, keeps one level per value; anything else continuous cut "sd_bands". title: tabxplor 2.0.0
text: tab() unified entry point. takes several row_vars col_vars, merged one table returned list output_list = TRUE, composes tab_vars; col_vars = *b crosses two column variables. tab_many() soft-deprecated alias. Every modelled effect sits beside observed (crude) counterpart — quantity fitted one predictor instead — adjustment changed read across table. color = "adjustment" colours gap tests ; empirical = FALSE turns . Every regression table checks : linearity, proportional odds, dispersion, influence collinearity, one footer row per model. shape = cure — fit continuous predictor quantile groups, curve, log / sqrt transformation. jamovi: new “Regression models” analysis (jmvtabreg); Crosstables gains reference-level picker, level merging, export, tooltips new options, named R argument. tab_counts() builds full colour-coded table already-aggregated counts instead microdata. forest_plot() draws tabxplor table estimates intervals, stars cell colours, returning modifiable ggplot; reg_check_plots() draws model checks. Weights survey designs. Pass survey::svydesign() data strata, clusters, fpc calibration reach every interval, test colour; options(tabxplor.design_effect = TRUE) , exactly, plain weight column. weighted table’s footer states basis. Correct confidence intervals, asymmetric (Wilson, Newcombe, Welch, Katz), chosen one named vector ci_method = c(cell =, diff =, mean_diff =, mean_ratio =). ci says interval sits; significance stars opt-(stars =) read interval. Whole-table tests: effect size (Cramér’s V, phi, eta²), Fisher’s exact sparse table, one-way ANOVA mean columns, Haberman’s adjusted residual behind color = "contrib". Redesigned colour API. Position picks visual channel (1st value → text, 2nd → background), color = TRUE smart per-column-type default, every ladder ladder written another measure, shade means deviation whichever measure table read . OKLCH palettes, set_color_palette(), color_breaks, theme = "auto" dark mode, black--white publication palettes (theme = "print_ready") saying typographically. One display grammar producers. Named layouts ("est", "est_ci", "est_base", …) built {} tokens — display = "{pct} (n={n})" — {est} whatever column estimates {base} level sits . post-hoc: set_display() finished table gives table asking build time. Every cell percentage table now carries odds ratio. shape = decides number enters table: quantile groups, bands mean one standard deviation either side, one level per value, "log" / "sqrt" transformation. numeric row_vars / tab_vars grouped rather exploded; mean cell shows 49 (cv 36%). spread_vars (level sub-table variable becomes block columns, one Total row one n column per block) n = c("range", "min", "") (many people table ) n_min, common_totrow na = "common_base". tab_export() one entry point every format, tab_html() (new name tab_kable()) renders new dependency-free engine, 3× faster restylable geometry CSS classes; tab_css() writes one stylesheet whole document. Also new: options(tabxplor.print = "html") hover tooltips, caption =, transpose = TRUE. Excel export moved openxlsx2: ratio stays real number sorts filters printing 1/2.11, column widths fit content, secondary number becomes column , tab_xl(check = "auto") draws model-check plots regression table. Introspection accessors. tab_structure() says table can done , tab_columns() every numeric column estimates coloured, fmt_attr() one column fact name, reg_measures() reg_formulas() models. .matrix() .table() hand table base R — numbers plain matrix, base table named dimnames — dropping totals display-time rows, correspondence analysis chi-squared test run table’s margins wrong: FactoMineR::CA(.matrix(tab(gss_cat, race, marital))).
